additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
During commissioning, the RUN/STOP LED on the PLC of Dispenser
K210 was orange.
The 230VAC power supply is present at the PLC, but output Q.7
does not deliver the signal required to enable the 24VDC.
I recommend replacing or flashing the PLC of the dispenser using
the Companion Tool.
